newsitem.title: FRANCE: Council of Europe warns Belarus on democracy.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe warns Belarus on democracy.

text.p: The Council of Europe's parliamentary assembly warned Belarus on Thursday that its chances of membership could be ruined if it did not abide by its constitution and respect democracy.

In a strongly-worded statement, the 39-nation pan-European body which promotes democracy and human rights urged President Alexander Lukashenko to postpone a referendum he plans in November on a new constitution greatly increasing his powers.

"Failure to abide by Belarus' present constitution and by the basic principles of democracy could only delay, if not terminate, the country's process of reform and its accession to the Council of Europe," the assembly's committee on relations with European non-member countries said in a statement.
It cited Lukashenko's refusal to abide by constitutional court judgments, growing restrictions on freedom of information and efforts to limit parliament's powers.

"The time has come to end these conflicts, which can but lead to paralysis of a country alreay prey to serious economic crisis. A goodwill gesture by both the president and the MPs is needed; this might take the form of postponement of the referendum," the statement said.
